report: The sisters have agreed to a nonbinding process, not an outcome: A will search their father’s papers/mail and any probate file, and share documents or leads with B and C. They will clarify the will, ownership, and options with independent estate-law advice before signing anything. If appropriate, they will then agree on an independent appraisal; afterward they can compare a voluntary buyout at supported market value, an open-market sale, or another consensual option. B’s studio plan is a goal, not a promised payout. C is open to considering a genuine market-value buyout but has not committed; no sale, buyout, valuation, or distribution has been authorized.
